_doc: Gold set for the RAG retrieval eval (evals/rag.py). Each question lists where its answer is in the course material: a chunk is relevant if its `fuente` ends with the given one and its text contains `contiene` (accents, case, markdown and spacing ignored). Labels are by content, not by chunk id or section, so they survive re-chunking. `recientes` are the consultation turns the student had seen (the search ignores them today). `fuera` questions have no answer in the material.
